Jwt._comment: DEV ONLY signing key. Local development convenience so the app runs without user-secrets. NEVER use this value in production — set a real secret via user-secrets or an environment variable there.

ConnectionStrings._comment: DEV ONLY. Names one developer's SQL Express instance, which is exactly why it must not live in the base appsettings.json — there it would be the fallback in every environment. On any other machine, override it without editing this tracked file: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:AscendantEmpireDatabase" "<your connection string>". User-secrets load after this file in Development, so they win.

ExportSettings._comment: DEV ONLY path. Kept so local exports keep landing where they always have; delete it to fall back to the machine-neutral <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/Exports default.

MapGenerationSettings._comment: DEV ONLY path. Kept so local map previews keep landing where they always have; delete it to fall back to the machine-neutral <system temp>/AscendantEmpire/MapPreviews default.
